title: SAM Overview: What, Why, How
description: Master the fundamental purpose of Software Asset Management — the one question that costs companies millions when answered wrong. Covers SAM vs HAM vs ITAM, the ELI5 analogy, and the SAM lifecycle.

title: The Three Record Types You Must Know
description: Never confuse these again: Software Model, Discovery Model, Installation, Usage, Entitlement, and Reconciliation Result. Includes the critical rule of thumb and table mapping each to its table, meaning, and creator.

title: Normalization Deep Dive: SUMN & Content Library
description: Why normalization is the foundation of all SAM: 40 variants of 'Microsoft Office' without it. Covers the 6 normalization statuses, suite membership criticality, Content Library publisher packs, and the 5-step normalization workflow.

title: Entitlements & License Metrics
description: The 7 must-have entitlement attributes and why metric mismatch is the #1 silent reconciliation failure. Covers perpetual vs subscription vs maintenance, entitlement hygiene rules, and the key fields table.

title: Reconciliation Engine: How Compliance Is Calculated
description: The core engine step-by-step: Compliance = f(entitlement, installs, usage, metric, rules). Includes the reconciliation flow diagram, compliance position states, what breaks reconciliation, and publisher-specific rules flows for Microsoft, Oracle, Adobe, IBM.

title: Compliance Positions Explained
description: All 6 compliance positions with financial meaning and typical actions: Compliant, Over-licensed, Under-licensed, Unlicensed, Not Counted, Unknown. Critical exam point: Unknown ≠ Compliant. Includes state transition diagram.

title: Publisher-Specific Traps (Microsoft, Oracle, IBM, SAP, Adobe)
description: The publisher rules that cause audit failures: Microsoft SQL Server cores & virtualization, Oracle core factors & server licensing, IBM PVU & ILMT, SAP indirect access, Adobe VIP/ETLA, ServiceNow fulfilled users. Exam favorites.

title: SaaS License Management & Seat Reclamation
description: SaaS vs on-premise comparison, the classic 26% M365 waste pattern (260/1000 never signed in 90 days), connector configuration essentials, and the reclamation workflow with 60-90 day inactivity windows.

title: Optimization & Reclamation Strategies
description: Priority order for SAM ROI: 1) Reclaim seats 2) Uninstall unused 3) Right-size editions 4) Consolidate tools 5) Align renewals 6) Enforce process. Plus the top 12 common mistakes table and key SAM program health metrics.

title: CIS-SAM Exam Prep: Domains, Quiz, Mnemonics
description: CIS-SAM 5 domains with weights (15/25/30/20/10%), 8 practice quiz questions with answers, memory mnemonics (BAA, LOCS, IRE, ARM), lab walkthrough, and official learning resources.
